who.question: Who you talk to
who.note: Your proposal names the person who handles your messages from discovery to launch.

updates.question: How often you hear from us
updates.note: Each phase ends with a review and your approval. Between sign-offs, the live preview link shows the build as it stands.

progress.question: Where you see progress
progress.note: From the first working build, so you judge the system itself - not screenshots of it.

yourPart.question: What we need from you
yourPart.note: The context in discovery, the copy and assets for the pages, and your approval at the end of each phase. The next phase starts once you approve.

changes.question: How a change is priced
changes.note: Changes within 5% of the agreed effort are included. Anything larger gets a written change order - a fixed price or {revisionRate} an hour - that you approve before work starts.

launch.question: Before it goes live
launch.note: You review the finished build on our staging environment. It moves to your domain once the final payment clears.

warranty.question: Warranty after launch
warranty.note: Critical fixes at no charge. After that, a maintenance plan or a new quote.

ownership.question: What you own
ownership.note: Source code, design files, hosting accounts and documentation pass to you at final payment. No lock-in.
